claim_label: programme-sealed, consumed-by-rule TEST-B (OD-1); never an unseen-family accuracy claim
decision_rule: programme goal met on TEST-B iff primary micro >= 0.85 (point estimate; CI reported). Secondaries are descriptive. TEST-B is run exactly once per lane and is CONSUMED afterwards: no re-run, no tuning, no lane change justified by TEST-B results.
dev_cli_consistency: the frozen CLI (config_v1, final models) reproduced the dump-pipeline selections exactly on all 125 DEV scans x 3 variants (375/375 identical line sets, pins_ok)

dev_oof_selection.why: zs - z3 = +0.030 micro, paired family bootstrap 95 % CI [+0.013, +0.050]; +0.039 macro [+0.015, +0.070]; 25 families better, 6 worse

expected_range.basis: DEV OOF 0.944 (125 scans) shrunk for selection/rule-design optimism (Z3 audit: touched 0.86 vs untouched 0.96) and for the FRESH-type distribution of TEST-B (DEV FRESH-DEV 17 line scans zs 0.950 / macro 0.893; the 4 newly frozen zs_v1 DEV scans zs 0.841; both outside Z2's rule design)

gold_of_record.provenance: OD-2 blind re-mark (2 markers) + adjudication, frozen in gold/GOLD_LEDGER.jsonl

gold_secondary_column.note: old FRESH labels (2026-10-17, 15 deg floor, not re-audited); comparison column only; read under freeze-ledger seq 8 (consumed-set diagnostics)

config.features: 21 Z3 + 5 pool flags (has_z3, in_z2, in_a0[always 0], n_src, ext_log_len)
config.placement: D1 gated outer-apex snap on the Z3 mesh

primary.name: zs_lane_v1 (Z3 + Z2 pooled GBM + D1 snap)

config.placement: D1 gated outer-apex snap on the Z3 mesh

config.features: none (Z2 it08 config: max_ro_t 12, min_span 8 mm)

secondary_2.name: Z2 alone (it08 flange graph, internal D1 snap)

metrics.also_reported: precision, recall, error budget (score_broad.diagnose, nearest counterpart within 15 deg / 15 mm), runtime per scan (median / P95 / max), each lane against the old FRESH labels as a secondary column
metrics.controls: zero-bend controls reported separately as FP lines (TEST-B has none by construction of the split, so this is expected to be empty)
metrics.failed_scans: a scan whose output is missing or FAILED is scored as an empty prediction: every gold line is a false negative; no scan is dropped; a matcher exclusion aborts scoring
metrics.family_macro: mean over part families (INVENTORY 'family') of family-micro F1
metrics.micro: summed TP/FP/FN over the complete-label line scans
metrics.primary_metric: micro line-F1 of the primary lane against the re-audit gold of record

run_procedure: each lane x scan through tools/guarded_slot.sh <sid> --final-testb (gold guard, one slot, OMP 1); the lane re-checks the guard and refuses on any pinned-hash mismatch or unpinned loaded module
a freeze-ledger RUN entry binds the run before scoring; a NOTE binds the results sha

scorer.matcher: research/broad_baseline/score.py score_case (frozen): 5 deg / 4 mm / 0.6 of both spans, one-to-one Hungarian, apex locus, raw scan frame

threshold_rule: fixed 0.5 on the GBM probability for every fold and for the final model (no threshold tuning). Rationale: the Bayes decision point of a probability model, set a priori; DEV OOF with fixed 0.5 equals the fold-tuned rule within noise (zs 0.944 fixed vs 0.939 tuned; z3 0.914 vs 0.913), and the Z3 audit found fixed 0.5 = 0.929 vs fold-tuned 0.930. Replaces lane.py's undocumented 0.55.
